One warm-up plus 50 recorded calls for each timing workload. The 13 correctness oracles run once each; they are regression coverage, not a model success-rate sample.
Generic no-change clicks still include the existing observation window. fill now observes queued input updates.
B10 intermittent iframe timeout reproduced in a separate interrupted repeat; no root cause established. Final default suite passed.
Long-task collection may miss delayed observer entries and is not a CPU profile.
